original_question: Ͻka kyerԑԑ Morisette ne Kael sԑ wɔmfa nnuaba mmra. Morisette de aprԑ 5 ne ankaa 8 na ԑbaaeԑ, na Kael de aprԑ a Morisette de baeԑ no mmɔho mmienu ne ankaa no mu fa na ԑbaeԑ. Nnuaba dodoɔ sԑn na wɔwɔ?
question_template: Ͻka kyerԑԑ {name_female, Morisette} ne {name_male, Kael} sԑ wɔmfa nnuaba mmra. {name_female, Morisette} de aprԑ {num_digit_1, 5} ne ankaa {num_digit_2, 8} na ԑbaaeԑ, na {name_male, Kael} de aprԑ a {name_female, Morisette} de baeԑ no {num_text_1, mmɔho mmienu} ne ankaa no mu {num_frac_1, fa} na ԑbaeԑ. Nnuaba dodoɔ sԑn na wɔwɔ?
question_solution: answer = (1 + k) * num_digit_1 + (1 + f) * num_digit_2   # k = numeric value of num_text_1 (twice→2, thrice→3, …); f = numeric value of num_frac_1 (half→1/2, third→1/3, quarter→1/4, two-thirds→2/3, …)
